title: Clinical and Ecological Impact of a Primary Care Antimicrobial Stewardship Program Based on Telematic Educational Interviews (TELÉMACO Trial)
official: Clinical and Ecological Impact of a Primary Care Antimicrobial Stewardship Program Based on Telematic Educational Interviews. A Cluster Randomized Clinical Trial (TELÉMACO Trial)
summary: Brief Summary: Open-label, cluster randomized, multicenter clinical trial to evaluate the clinical and ecological impact of a Primary Care ASP based on telematic educational interviews.
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:

a) Primary Care centres within the reference area of the University Hospital Virgen del Rocío.

Exclusion criteria:

1. Emergency departments.
2. Odontology offices.
3. DDD per Health centre less than 5.78
